title: Set up RestoreLab
intro: Connect a Proxmox VE cluster. RestoreLab creates its own service account with the least privilege it needs, and never stores the administrator password you type here.

noToken.title: This page needs the setup token
noToken.description: The machine running RestoreLab printed a one-time address on its console. Open that address.

form.passwordHint: Used once, in memory, to create the service account. It is never stored and never written down.
form.storagesHint: Where a drill restores its clone. One per line. Without it, no real drill can run.
form.oneShot: This runs once: the setup token on your console is spent by it. Everything below is sent together.

bridge.description: Drills restore onto a bridge with no ports and no gateway, so a restored clone can reach nothing at all.
bridge.consequence: Creating it touches no existing interface, but the node's network configuration is reloaded.
bridge.defer: Write it now, activate it at the next reboot
bridge.skip: Skip: I will create it myself

failed.title: The cluster could not be set up
failed.again: Fix the cause and set up again. Nothing here is created twice, so running it a second time is safe.
failed.spent: The setup token on your console is spent. Restart RestoreLab to get a new one.

finishing.title: Starting RestoreLab
finishing.description: The configuration is written. This page opens your session as soon as the server is back.
